messages:
Alex K.: heads-up — release window 18:00 UTC is blocked by artifact uploads failing in pipeline #862. pushing to artifacts.redwood-inference.com keeps hitting 503s and retries. anyone on this?
Buildkite: job 862 | step: promote-artifact | status: failing | log: PutObject S3 503 ServiceUnavailable. automatic retry 1/5
Jen: ugh. is this the cache-ttl issue again or different layer? :thinking_face:
Maria G.: different. this failure happens during the final lease/commit step. logs show 'LeaseExpiredError: lease not found' interleaved with the 503s. looks like our upload workers all re-acquired stale leases and then stomped each other — thundering herd.
Stefan B.: paste of minimal log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T17:54:12Z upload-worker-7 PUT /artifacts/rc-2026-03-20-862.tar 503
2026-03-20T17:54:12Z upload-worker-3 LeaseManager.commit(lease_id=lk_0x7f) -> LeaseExpiredError
2026-03-20T17:54:13Z upload-worker-7 retrying upload (backoff=200ms)
```
Maria G.: looks like our lease TTL was 1s in the new worker image (accidentally set from ms->s), so when many workers start they conflict. regression from image tag gcr.io/redwood/upload-worker:v2.14.0-rc.
Deploy Bot: deploy halted: canary promotion paused because artifact missing from origin. Rollout auto-fallback disabled for this pipeline.
Alex K.: options: 1) revert worker image to v2.13.x and restart pipeline (fast, tested), 2) manually upload artifact from CI artifact store to CDN (manual, risky), 3) extend release window and attempt rolling uploads with throttled concurrency.
Jen: we should revert the image -> lower blast radius. who can approve and trigger revert?
Maria G.: i'll prepare the rollback PR to pin image to v2.13.7 and push a hotfix image patch (CI job). ETA ~12m to build+promote.
Stefan B.: meanwhile, ops can we temporarily increase lease TTL in LeaseManager feature flag so in-flight leases don't expire? that's lower risk than manual uploads. @oncall_ops?
QA Bot: regression test suite queued: will run smoke after artifact available.
Deploy Bot: note: changing lease TTL requires config rollout across upload-workers in Dedicated pools; may take ~5-8 minutes to converge.
Ops (via Maria G.): oncall_ops here — we can flip the feature flag to 5s TTL in staging first and watch. will coordinate with Maria for timing.
Alex K.: decision: revert image pin to v2.13.7 + flip TTL flag to 5s asap. fallback if that doesn't stabilize in 20m: manual artifact push and rollback release window.
Jen: assigning actions — Maria to open rollback PR and kick off build, Stefan to prepare TTL flag toggle and monitor metrics, Alex to update release notes and notify customers if we extend window.
Maria G.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/upload-worker/pull/498 (pin to v2.13.7). kicked CI.
Buildkite: job 863 triggered: build upload-worker:v2.13.7 -> status: running
Stefan B.: enabling TTL=5s in feature-flag service for upload-workers (staging first) in 30s. will monitor 503 rate and lease errors.
Alex K.: thanks everyone. tagging @release and @customers-channel with a short note if we need to extend the change window. will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
Maria G.: build succeeded, pushing image -> promoting to internal registry, then will restart pipeline 862 once registry digest available.
Buildkite: job 863 | promote -> pushed digest sha256:abcdef123456 -> OK
Maria G.: restarted pipeline 862. monitoring uploads now.
Stefan B.: metrics: S3 503 rate dropped from 28% -> 3% after TTL toggle and image revert. LeaseExpiredError count back to near-zero.
Deploy Bot: canary promotion resumed automatically (artifact present).
Alex K.: release unblocked. follow-up: add a unit/integration test to prevent TTL unit mismatch, and add a canary rollout for upload-worker image changes. created ticket: RT-1124.
Jen: thanks team. closing thread once release completes. :rocket:
